rules.rule: Read the 'When the diff touches Cloudflare, caching, middleware, headers or bindings' section of docs/PRE_PR_REVIEW.md and the headings of docs/FOOTGUNS.md first. Check that cacheComponents stays off, and that any cache or binding the config relies on has its matching entry in wrangler.jsonc.

Read the 'When the diff touches Cloudflare, caching, middleware, headers or bindings' section of docs/PRE_PR_REVIEW.md and the headings of docs/FOOTGUNS.md first. Check that any incremental cache, tag cache or queue added here has its binding (R2 bucket, KV namespace, Durable Object, service) declared in wrangler.jsonc.

Read the 'When the diff touches Cloudflare, caching, middleware, headers or bindings' section of docs/PRE_PR_REVIEW.md first. Check that a change here comes with a regenerated cloudflare-env.d.ts in the same diff, and that compatibility_flags keeps nodejs_compat.

Server code runs on Cloudflare workerd, not Node: flag Node-only APIs not covered by nodejs_compat, and filesystem access at request time. The QR code generator runs only in the browser: flag any code that sends user input to a server or stores it.

Hooks must run on macOS /bin/bash 3.2: no mapfile, readarray or associative arrays, and guard empty-array expansion under set -u. Check for set -euo pipefail, quoted variables, and that the hook never stages changes the user left unstaged.
